# Vitality Supply

> HPLC-documented research peptides for qualified laboratories. Research use only. Not for human or animal consumption. Not a drug. Not FDA approved.

- Shop: https://vitalitysupply.org/
- Testing & COA requests: https://vitalitysupply.org/testing
- Research-use terms: https://vitalitysupply.org/legal/research-use
- Privacy: https://vitalitysupply.org/legal/privacy
- Terms: https://vitalitysupply.org/legal/terms
- Contact: https://vitalitysupply.org/contact

Materials are supplied as analytical / in-vitro research compounds with lot identity (CAS, HPLC purity, molecular weight on each product page). Certificates of analysis are issued on request. Illinois and federal RUO rules apply.
